motion_blur.direction_method: directional evidence from radial spectrum only; no unique PSF claimed

leave_one_out.method: raw crop resize only proxy; no saved fusion image and no canonical output used for raw measurements
leave_one_out.interpretation: This proxy tests temporal consistency after resizing raw crops to a common frame-385 size. It cannot prove super-resolution because scale changes and interpolation are confounded.

raw_frames_2x_bicubic.resize: bicubic OCR input only; no saved final image

raw_frames_3x_bicubic.resize: bicubic OCR input only; no saved final image

limitations: Exposure time is unavailable; 1/60, 1/120, and 1/250 trail estimates are scenarios, not measurements.
The HSV bbox is a measurement ROI detector, not a claim that HSV is a general detector.
Edge spread uses fixed diagnostic coordinates and raw grayscale intensity profiles; anisotropy remains unconfirmed until axis-aligned edge spread is independently checked.
OCR ground truth is an assumption from the requested strings; no user confirmation was available.
